# Real PIX computation on synthetic inputs

Generated by `scripts/pix-worker-check.py` against the exact PIX Python source pin recorded in `evidence.json`. Requests contain synthetic cases, while native computation documents came from the actual unmodified PIX public APIs. They are not fake model responses or production observations.

The reflection denominator is 20 (12 ordinary successes, 6 reproduce-first successes, 2 failures). Awareness uses separate case IDs and a frozen graph. Extra review incurs empirical edit cost without a business/policy violation verdict. The limited fixtures preserve partial status and omit an incomplete frozen model.

`evidence.json` records every fixture byte digest and the consumer worker digest. Reproduction and supported-profile boundaries are documented in `docs/PIX-CAPABILITIES.md`. These fixtures do not establish actual Persona integration, live LLM quality, Windows support or long-term improvement.
